classification.difficultyReason: Apply the demonstrated symmetry and complement identities to four negative z-scores using the standard normal table.

content.prompt:
For a dataset that is normally distributed, find the probability that a randomly chosen score has a z-score as described in each part. Give answers to 4 decimal places using the standard normal table values below.

| $z$ | $P(Z\le z)$ |
| --- | --- |
| $1.19$ | $0.8830$ |
| $1.42$ | $0.9222$ |
| $2.07$ | $0.9808$ |
| $2.21$ | $0.9864$ |
